title: Exploring LGBTQ+ Bias in Generative AI Answers across Different Country and Religious Contexts

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting conversational AI models (ChatGPT 3.5 and Bard) with explicit homophobic statements and evaluating the generated responses using qualitative thematic analysis and descriptive statistics to determine the level of explicit or implicit support for LGBTQ+ individuals.

Modifying homophobic prompts by adding contextual background information about the hypothetical user's religion (Orthodox Christian, Conservative Muslim) or country (Russia, Saudi Arabia) to assess whether the models alter their stance based on cultural relativism versus universal human rights frameworks.
